channel.title: Aniimo Tools News
channel.description: Official Aniimo news, updates and patch notes, summarised and sourced.

item.title: Aniimo Pre-Download Is Open: Launch Server Times, Accounts and New Specs
item.description: Pre-download opened on September 14 at 10:00 UTC+8 on PC, PS5 and Xbox. The notice names the three launch servers and their opening times, sets the account rules across platforms, and replaces the PC specs with lower ones while publishing iOS and Android requirements for the first time.

item.title: Pawprint's Pre-Launch Letter Is Really a Changelog: Runes Cut, Irisalis Redesigned
item.description: The dev team's letter confirms Xbox cloud gaming at launch and lists what changed since the beta: the rune system is gone, legendary capture is rebuilt around crafted Aniipods, Prismana odds are flattened, and a new Umbral variant guarantees Perfect Potential.

item.title: Aniimo Launches September 16 on PC and Consoles, September 23 on Mobile
item.description: Pawprint Studio dated Aniimo at gamescom Opening Night Live: September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and Epic, then September 23 on iOS and Android, with more than 200 Aniimo at launch.

item.title: Aniimo Pre-Order Packs Land on PS5 and Xbox With Platform-Exclusive Accessories
item.description: Two optional console pre-order packs opened alongside the launch date: an Advanced Edition at $9.99 and a Collector's Edition at $19.99, with Fluffy Friend on PlayStation and Doggo Dude on Xbox. The game itself stays free.

item.title: Aniimo Will Let You Talk to Your Creatures With NVIDIA ACE After Launch
item.description: NVIDIA dates it to early 2027: an update will let Pathfinders speak to their Aniimo in natural language, chatting, teaching skills and sending them gathering by voice, with a fine-tuned Nemotron model running locally on the player's own GPU.

item.title: Time to Aniimo: The Pre-Launch Web Event That Pays Out on Launch Day
item.description: Aniimo ran a browser warm-up event from August 26 to September 3, 2026: log in daily to hatch Aniimo and exchange them with friends, then receive a Limited-Edition Profile Card Background in game at global launch.

item.title: The Global Closed Beta Ended July 25, and the Bond Pact Sealed One Aniimo per Player
item.description: Aniimo's third closed beta closed its servers on July 25, 2026 across three regional shards and wiped every account. The Bond Pact event let each Pathfinder seal one Aniimo in an egg to reclaim at global launch.

item.title: Welcome to Idyll: Inside the Global Closed Beta's Opening Day Events
item.description: The official opening notice set the per-region server times and launched two day-one events: the Set Out, Pathfinder! check-in ladder and Prismana Promise, a free Prismana form Aniimo of your own choosing.

item.title: Aniimo's Global Closed Beta Opens July 9 Across PC, Mobile and Steam
item.description: Aniimo's third closed beta, the Global CBT, starts July 9 (UTC+8) on PC, iOS, Android and Steam, with the water-themed Island of Peace, Aniimo trading and the Diamond Egg Heist PvP mode.

item.title: Aniimo Launches 'Observation Diary' Creature-Reveal Shorts Series
item.description: The official @Aniimo_EN channel is running an ongoing Observation Diary Shorts series that profiles one creature per episode ahead of the Global Closed Beta.

item.title: IDLX 2026 Aniimo Global Vote Opens: Winner Earns a New Regal Form
item.description: Aniimo's official IDLX 2026 Global Vote lets players pick their favourite creature, and the winner earns a brand-new Regal Form at global launch.

item.title: Aniimo Opens Pre-Registration Lucky Draw for the Third Closed Beta
item.description: Aniimo's official pre-registration lucky draw handed out entries for signing up and sharing, with an iPhone 17 Pro Max, a PS5 and an Xbox Series X headlining the prize pool.

item.title: Aniimo Reveals Q3 2026 Launch Window and Global Closed Beta at Future Games Show
item.description: Pawprint Studio debuted a new gameplay trailer at the Future Games Show, confirming a Q3 2026 global launch and a Global Closed Beta Test.

item.title: Aniimo's Global Creator Recruitment Opens to Worldwide Pathfinders
item.description: Aniimo's Creator Team invites players to make content from their journeys, with closed beta access and direct dev feedback among the rewards.

item.title: Aniimo's Publisher Changes from Kingsglory to Pawprint Interactive Entertainment
item.description: From 15 April 2026 Aniimo is published by Pawprint Interactive Entertainment, and only your registration data carries over from Kingsglory.

item.title: Aniimo Adds PlayStation 5 and Epic Games Store, Debuts at PAX East with New Creature Hoptail
item.description: Pawprint Studio expands the launch lineup to PS5 and the Epic Games Store, and reveals the electric creature Hoptail in a playable PAX East demo.

item.title: Aniimo Adds NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 for Smoother Exploration Across Idyll
item.description: The team is integrating DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation and Super Resolution to lift frame rates and cut stutter while exploring Idyll.

item.title: CBT2 'Paws Up' Patch Log: Every Notable Change, Jan 26–Feb 6
item.description: A running changelog of the daily CBT2 'Paws Up' update notices, from early story-blocker fixes to the Egg Heist co-op overhaul and DX12 loading work.

item.title: Reunion Promise: Seal One Aniimo to Carry Into Launch in CB2 Event
item.description: Aniimo's second closed beta lets each player lock a single creature inside an Egg that hatches back into their roster when the game officially launches.

item.title: Aniimo's Second Closed Beta Wraps Up on February 8
item.description: The Second Closed Beta closes February 8 at 23:59 (UTC+8) with a full data wipe, but three events carry keepsakes and a companion pact through to launch.

item.title: Aniimo's February 2 Update Answers Week-One Beta Feedback With a Balance Overhaul
item.description: After a week of closed beta, the developers ease progression pressure with catching, combat, and Egg Heist tuning plus a round of bug fixes.

item.title: Aniimo's January 29 Update Adds Egg Heist and Holo-Battle Interlink Modes
item.description: The January 29 patch debuts two new modes and trims grind costs across the board, with mail compensation for all players.

item.title: Aniimo Eases Experience Gem Crunch With Free Gems and Cheaper Shop Prices
item.description: Responding to player feedback after the Title Levels update, the team is handing out free Experience Gems and lowering their shop cost.

item.title: Aniimo's January 25 Update Squashes 18 Bugs and Cues Up Two New Events
item.description: A maintenance patch clears mission-blocking bugs, polishes skills and visuals, and sets up the Shining Star Audition and Aniimo Discovery events the next morning.

item.title: Aniimo Second Closed Beta Delayed by Technical Issues
item.description: Pawprint pushes back the Second Closed Beta Test on launch day, offering login compensation while it resolves a story-blocking bug.

item.title: Aniimo's Second Closed Beta, "Paws Up," Opens January 23
item.description: Sign-ups for Aniimo's second closed beta close January 20, with the test launching January 23 and showcasing new regions, the Egg Heist mode, and reworked social features.

item.title: Aniimo Launches Its First iOS Technical Test on TestFlight
item.description: Aniimo's debut mobile technical test invites fewer than 300 US players onto TestFlight for a short, performance-focused trial on recent iPhones.

item.title: Aniimo Opens Its Second Beta Test Creator Program to Content Makers
item.description: Pawprint Studio invites streamers and video creators to apply for an official role sharing the world of Idyll ahead of Aniimo's second beta test.

item.title: Aniimo's Second Closed Beta Opens Sign-Ups on PC and iOS
item.description: Recruitment for Aniimo's Second Closed Beta Test begins December 12, with registration handled through an official questionnaire.

item.title: Aniimo Made by You: 12 Player Designs Win a Spot at Global Launch
item.description: Pawprint Studio names two Grand Prize winners and ten runners-up from 600 community-designed creatures, all bound for the live game at Global Launch.

item.title: New Tokyo Game Show Trailer Lands Alongside the 'Design Your Aniimo' Contest
item.description: Pawprint Studio's latest Aniimo trailer tours the world of Idyll, and a creature-design contest invites fans to put their own Aniimo into the game.

item.title: Summer Party, Carnival Time! Aniimo's Beta Finale Events
item.description: Two limited-time send-off events thank Paw-up Beta Pathfinders with boosted drops and Sparkling spawns before official launch.

item.title: Aniimo Opens Its Closed Beta to Pathfinders on July 4th
item.description: Aniimo invites a select group of Pathfinders into an exclusive pre-release closed beta beginning July 4th, with applications closing June 30th.

item.title: Aniimo Opens Closed Beta Sign-Ups for PC and Xbox
item.description: Pawprint Studio invites players to apply for Aniimo's first NDA-free closed beta, a minimum seven-day test on PC and Xbox.

item.title: Aniimo's Beta Survival Handbook: What Idyll Testers Need to Know
item.description: The official onboarding guide for the Idyll closed beta lays out hardware needs, the two combat modes, and how to file feedback during the test window.

item.title: Aniimo's Pathfinders' Summer Camp Runs a Week of Beta Activities
item.description: A seven-day beta event from the Polaris Institute bundles eight themed activities, from daily check-ins to creature research, into one summer celebration.

item.title: How to Confirm Your Spot and Prepare for Aniimo's Closed Beta
item.description: Aniimo's preparation guide walks accepted testers through verifying their place, pre-downloading the client, and what to expect during the PC-only beta window.

item.title: Welcome to Aniimo: Closed Beta Opens Ahead of 2026 Launch
item.description: Pawprint Studio's free-to-play creature-collecting ARPG opens its closed beta and pre-registration ahead of a 2026 cross-platform release.
